Name: BOOST_PARAM_ST
Description: Booster settings: the counter boost particle effects and where they play, and the booster direction interpolation rates.

Fields.Name: Counter Boost: Particle ID [1]
Fields.Description: Counter boost particle effect played from the dummy poly in Counter Boost: Dummy Polygon ID [1].

Fields.Name: Counter Boost: Particle ID [2]
Fields.Description: Counter boost particle effect played from the dummy poly in Counter Boost: Dummy Polygon ID [2].

Fields.Name: Counter Boost: Particle ID [3]
Fields.Description: Counter boost particle effect played from the dummy poly in Counter Boost: Dummy Polygon ID [3].

Fields.Name: Counter Boost: Dummy Polygon ID [1]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly that plays the particle effect in Counter Boost: Particle ID [1].

Fields.Name: Counter Boost: Dummy Polygon ID [2]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly that plays the particle effect in Counter Boost: Particle ID [2].

Fields.Name: Counter Boost: Dummy Polygon ID [3]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly that plays the particle effect in Counter Boost: Particle ID [3].

Fields.Name: Particle Size Scale
Fields.Description: Size multiplier for the particle effects. 1.0: as is; 0.5: half size.

Fields.Name: Effective Counter Boost Angle
Fields.Description: Angle range within which counter boost is active. In degrees. At 90, it is active when the dot product of the movement direction and the dummy poly direction is 0 or more.

Fields.Name: Boost Direction Interpolation Rate
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate of the booster's direction change during a normal boost. Rate per frame.

Fields.Name: Counter Boost Direction Interpolation Rate
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate of the booster's direction change during a counter boost. Rate per frame.
